name: Cursed Manacles of the Obedient Follower

system.description:
This object is cursed. It can only be removed with the rightful key, or with a @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.l16wg9h1z9s16exb]{Remove Curse} or @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.pe52jryde7ljobzq]{Wish} spell.

Upon clapping these manacles around the wrists of a target, the attunement process begins. After one hour, the wearer is attuned to the manacles, which are fused with the skin and will accommodate growth if the target wears them for multiple years.

When forcibly clapped in these irons, the wearer cannot attack, cast spells on, or cause indirect harm to the one holding the key (i.e.: setting a room on fire while the key-holder just happens to be in, unleashing a leashed hostile that would charge the key-holder, etc.)

The wearer will view the key-holder as their direct superior and as an ally, in logic if not in emotion –they are free to find the key-holder physically repulsive or disagreeable, but will follow orders as if part of a higher allegiance. The wearer will not question orders to attack any creature hostile to the key-holder, and any orders as if under the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.9s4sb34j24r74328]{Dominate Person}/@UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.9pyk9fklr2xff0ue]{Dominate Monster} etc. spells.

The wearer can make a DC15 Wisdom saving throw to refuse to attack a creature that was previously their ally, but on a success they will take 1d10 psychic damage.

nM71V10ozeBNNaNl.name: Cursed Manacles of the Obedient Follower

system.craftingComponents: Chains, shackles (or the metal ingot required to forge a pair of shackles), a few drops of acid to bite the runes into the metal as the curse is cast (and knowledge of the spell required or a bestow curse scroll)
